# wayfinder

Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

Ships in the [`mpocock`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Needs an issue tracker: GitHub with the gh CLI, GitLab with the glab CLI, or local markdown files in .scratch/ (the fallback). Research tickets need a harness that can run subagents. Run it by hand; the model does not load it.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add mpocock@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install mpocock@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
